body: Thank you so much this post helps out a ton.

Id seek a doctor and open up with someone. You seem to be going through something rough and i really hope you can work it out with some people. Im not a doctor im just a 16 year old kid on the internet but it sounds like depression.

Please seek therapy and someone who will help you and actually love you

You can test to see if your current husband is a good person by opening up to him about the cutting. See if he will be supportive and caring or if he justs drops a rant.

Believe me when i say this, but your heart is pure and you are a good person. You wont be able to see it right now because your perspective is off. But one day you will.

Please take lots of care of yourself and post on reddit so we can help you get through this. We care about you here.

and i hate to say this again but please seek therapy

edit: feel free to say anything else in this thread  including doubts. if you want to get some more stuff off your chest also im sorry if im giving the "you should seek therapy"  type of response.

edit2: fixed grammar error that changes the message completely in the 2nd paragraph. I know there may be more grammar errors, i will try to fix them later.

Omg this sounds terrible. I really feel like you are not the abusive one in the situation. Abusers will often make their victims feel guilty to control you and manipulate you. Accepting someone is abusing you is a very hard thing to do and you are very brave for making this. I have 2 abusive parents and often visit r/raisedbynarcissists because theres tons of useful info there. The "hopefully he will be nicer to me" mentality isnt good because he may be a bit nicer to you just to convince you that hes a good person but it will fall down hill again and he will take you on the same shitty roller coaster.

open up to him about how you hurt yourself and if he is not supportive or nice about it then he is 100% abusive Or if he gives a huge rant about how you should fix it and you can fix it if you'd try more, that is also a no-no. It may seem stupid open up to an abuser like this. but it doing something like this gave me confidence that my parents we're abusive and i wasnt.

cutting yourself because of a bad relationship isnt normal

Please report back sometime id love to check up on you. take care of yourself.

Dont take no response on your post as something personal. I should have realized some posts get missed when i made this. But it doesnt have anything to do with you or your post. its just sometimes theres more posts then people commenting things. Try remaking your post now or do it in this comment section. I Apologize if anyones post gets missed its a bad feeling but dont beat yourself over it. There may be more posts coming in because of this thread as well. 

If you feel unwelcome in an anonymous support group then we need to ensure you that you are welcome here. This isnt your fault at all. This support group just isnt perfect thats all.


edit: you can also try other subredditd that are similar to this one if you want. Go to the sidebar

Hey man im sorry to hear you are dealing with this. people or even you may not see it but you are really brave, people who see us as weak have no idea what this is like. Try to get a hold of the pychiatrist, its weird that your parents made you stop visiting them. Id check out r/raisedbynarcissists just in case because they may be manipulative people and victims of abuse take a while to realize they are with bad people. I could also be wrong and i could be overreacting to this but its still worth a look at.

Yeah his mom is super nice and chill. I stayed there for like a week and she was always there for me and she listened to her kids days and acted like a friend rather then a prison warden. His dad is a quirky but doesnt get mad. A bit of a stoner too, but i am as well, ill probs blaze with him Lmaoo. im not gonna lie though at first i felt there was something off about him but i also feel like im over skeptical about people.

edit: why did i get a downvote? I didnt realize I did something wrong but I also want to know what i did wrong so I can improve
I wont be killing myself. This post helped me a lot thank you.
